conviction_note: The findings net to 0.0 after lessons (-0.6 before). They split between a possible Q4 revenue beat from seasonality and protest-delayed revenue, and a set of negatives: the Q4 free cash flow needed to hit guidance, NASA insourcing confirmed by KBR, and a peer pattern of selling revenue shortfalls. The first formal FY27 guide decides the print, and management already framed it near flat (core mid-single-digit growth less 3% NASA less 1% exits), so I have no sourced number the market lacks. p_up is 48, nudged below 50 only by the 6.5-point put skew and this name's history of selling EPS beats on revenue. abs_move stays at about the option-implied 11% because this is a first guide on a stock 44% off its high.
bar: Q4 FY26 consensus: adjusted EPS $0.66 and revenue about $3.66B (Earnings Whispers preview, 2026-11-16, https://finviz.com/news/423364/amentums-margin-story-faces-a-revenue-test-as-fy2027-outlook-looms). Chartmill has $0.67 and $3.77B (https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/AMTM/estimates), so the EPS figures agree and the revenue figures do not. The company guide resolves the revenue bar. FY26 guide (8-K 2026-08-10, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0002011286/000162828026055294/exhibit991-august102026.htm): revenue $13.80-13.95B, adj. EBITDA $1.115-1.14B, adj. EPS $2.40-2.50, FCF $525-575M. YTD Q1-Q3 revenue was 3,237 + 3,478 + 3,490 = $10.205B, so the implied Q4 is revenue $3.595-3.745B (midpoint $3.67B, matching the $3.66B consensus), adj. EBITDA $287-312M (YTD 263 + 275 + 290 = 828) and FCF $312-362M (YTD $213M). The FY27 bar has no sourced consensus figure. Management's Q3-call framework is mid-single-digit growth in the remaining portfolio less about 3% for NASA insourcing and about 1% for exited low-margin programs, which is roughly flat; Earnings Whispers puts it at 0-1%.
positioning_check: Short interest was 14.05M shares with 7.2 days to cover as of the 2026-10-30 settlement, on 1.95M average daily volume and 244.5M shares outstanding (https://massive.com/quote/amtm.md, read 2026-11-23). That is about 5.7% of shares outstanding and roughly 9% of a ~152.5M float. Yahoo showed 7.86% of float on 2026-08-31 and Equibles about 5% in mid-August, so shorts have been building since the Q3 print. Elevated but not crowded (below the 18-23% squeeze cases). A sponsor joint venture (American Securities and Lindsay Goldberg) held 90.0M shares per its 2024 13D, a supply overhang; I found no 2026 sale. Baseline: 25-delta skew +6.48 vol points (downside paid), put/call OI 0.29 on a thin chain (827 OI, ATM spread 27% of mid), event-implied move 11.48%. Spot $20.95 is -44% from the 52-week high, +15.6% from the low, -5.1% over 20 days and -2.4% over 5. Earnings Whispers calls sentiment 'firmly bearish' since the last report.

findings.finding: The first FY27 guide will carry NASA insourcing at the upper bound already flagged: management said on the 2026-08-11 call that NASA insourcing would cut about 3% of FY27 revenue (up from about 1% a quarter earlier), with 'not all contract actions in hand'. Since then, Amentum announced 70 layoffs at Kennedy Space Center due by 2026-11-30 (2026-09-28), and KBR's MTS segment reported revenue down about 5% on reduced NASA science and space programs plus a NASA insourcing debooking (book-to-bill 0.9x, 1.0x ex the debooking; reported 2026-10-29). The risk is a NASA cut above the 3% already framed, against a market that expects a near-flat FY27.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY26 (2026-08-10): revenue guide cut and the NASA headwind raised from 1% to 3%; the stock fell 8.22% despite raised EBITDA and EPS guides. Q4 FY25 (2025-11-24), when the first FY26 guide was given: +18.25%. So this line has moved the stock both ways by 8-18 points.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The 3% is public and the stock has fallen since. Not priced: whether 3% is still the number after NASA's plan firmed and KBR booked a debooking. If the market expected a larger hit, consensus FY27 revenue would be below flat, and the preview (2026-11-16) still frames FY27 at 0-1% growth.
findings.independence: KBR Q3 FY26 (different company, direct NASA counterparty on the same insourcing): https://mfn.se/all/a/kbr/kbr-reports-third-quarter-fiscal-2026-results-8a641f71. Kennedy layoffs: https://samsearch.co/government-contracting-news/nasa-reclaims-operations-at-kennedy-space-center-layoffs-announced-204877 (2026-09-28). Both are independent of the WT article, but they confirm the direction of a headwind already framed, not its size.

findings.finding: The FY26 guide implies Q4 revenue of only +3% to +7% over Q3 ($3.595-3.745B against $3.49B). Last year Q4 rose about 10% over Q3 ($3.56B to $3.92B) and beat consensus by $310M on government fiscal year-end volume. Management also attributed about $175M of FY26 revenue to protest and procurement delays, and the main protests have since been resolved in Amentum's favour: COSMOS and CMOE II in Q3, and GAO denied HII's protest of a ~$708M Navy task order on 2026-11-05. Q4 revenue at or above the top of the implied range is plausible against a $3.66B consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue is the line this stock trades on. Q3 FY26: an EPS beat ($0.67 vs $0.61) with a revenue miss ($3.49B vs ~$3.58-3.6B) sold off 8.2%. Q4 FY25: revenue beat by $310M, together with the first FY26 guide, +18.25%. Q1 FY26: revenue -5% (shutdown, JV transitions), -12.38%.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus sits at the midpoint of the implied guide, so the Street has not modelled last year's Q4 seasonality on top of it. If it had, the $3.66B consensus would sit near the $3.75B top, and Chartmill's $3.77B shows at least one dissenting estimate. This is inference from seasonality, not a company number, and last year's Q4 included divested and deconsolidated work.
findings.independence: Q3 FY26 release for the $175M delay and protest resolutions: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0002011286/000162828026055294/exhibit991-august102026.htm. HII protest denied (2026-11-05), from the GAO protest search via https://www.gao.gov/products/b-424562,b-424562.2. Both are separate documents from the FY25 Q4 release this finding is sized on.

findings.finding: Holding the FY26 FCF guide of $525-575M needs Q4 free cash flow of $312-362M (YTD $213M through Q3). That is 20-39% above Q4 FY25's $261M, on a name with 3.0x net leverage. YTD FCF is also behind last year (FY25 YTD through Q3 was about $255M = $516M full year less $261M in Q4). A low-end or missed FCF print keeps leverage near 3x and slows deleveraging.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4 FY25 (strong $261M FCF, FY25 $516M): +18.25%, though the guide was also given that day. No clean isolated FCF reaction in the baseline.
findings.why_not_priced: Previews focus on revenue and the FY27 guide; the Earnings Whispers preview does not mention the Q4 cash requirement. This lands inside a guide the company reaffirmed in August knowing the YTD figure, which is why it is sized small. If the market doubted the cash, the skew would read the same, so this does not separate.
findings.independence: FY25 Q4 FCF $261M and full-year $516M from the FY25 Q4 release: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2011286/000162828025053839/exhibit991-november242025.htm. Same company, two documents.

findings.finding: Awards and protest wins since the Q3 call support FY27 backlog and book-to-bill: NORAD NISSC III $572M (Sep 2026), NASA $256M (2026-10-07), Navy multi-engine trainer $490M (2026-10-28), UK SMR $406M, a partner seat on a $5B, 20-year Fermilab contract (2026-11-04), and the HII protest denial (2026-11-05). Q3 backlog was $48.2B with 1.3x trailing book-to-bill.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Backlog and bookings have not saved a revenue miss here: Q3 FY26 had record backlog and still fell 8.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: each award was press-released. What is not priced is the sum, shown as Q4 book-to-bill and the FY27 revenue it supports, which only the release will reveal.
findings.independence: Navy $490M and NASA $256M briefs: https://www.stockopedia.com/share-prices/amentum-holdings-NYQ:AMTM/news/brief-amentum-awarded-490m-contract-to-modernize-u-s-navy-s-multi-engine-training-aircraft-fleet-019e6db5-5ee4-7a36-bb56-a2d68195b483/ and Fermilab: https://www.stockopedia.com/share-prices/amentum-holdings-NYQ:AMTM/news/brief-amentum-a-partner-on-fermi-national-accelerator-laboratory-contract-award-019e6db7-6cdb-7e3f-97ac-cf6af9206abd/

findings.finding: The government runs on a continuing resolution only to 2026-12-11 (H.R. 6500, signed early September). Bloomberg Government reports that Democrats' midterm gains complicate the funding talks, and Goldman expects another stopgap. Q1 FY27 therefore opens under a CR with a renewed shutdown risk, and Q1 FY26 revenue was hit by the 2025 shutdown, so the FY27 guide may be set conservatively or carry a shutdown caveat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY26 (2026-02-09): revenue -5% partly on the 2025 shutdown, -12.38%.
findings.why_not_priced: Macro-to-company proxy, not confirmed by the company. It is visible to the whole sector, so it is largely in the multiple; the only unpriced part is how much caution management builds into the guide.

findings.finding: Positioning is bearish into a print whose main line, a near-flat FY27, management has already pre-framed. Short interest rose to 14.05M shares and 7.2 days to cover (2026-10-30) from about 5% of float in August, the stock sits 44% below its high near post-Q3 lows, and Earnings Whispers calls sentiment 'firmly bearish'. An in-line flat guide with a Q4 revenue beat has a covering mechanism.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4 FY25 from depressed levels: +18.25%. Q2 FY26 (in-line, reaffirmed): +1.55%.
findings.why_not_priced: The +6.5-point put skew says the option market leans down, so a squeeze is not in the price. At roughly 9% of float this is elevated but not crowded, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: V2X, the closest operations, logistics and aviation-sustainment peer, reported on 2026-11-02, after Amentum last spoke: revenue +9% y/y to $1.27B, book-to-bill 1.2x, and FY26 revenue, adj. EBITDA, EPS and cash guides all raised (revenue to $4.95-5.10B). That points to healthy DoD operations and sustainment demand in the quarter ending ~2026-10-02.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No baseline record of AMTM reacting to V2X prints.
findings.why_not_priced: A peer read that arrived after Amentum's last statement. Amentum consensus has not visibly moved since (Q4 revenue $3.66B, at the guide midpoint). Link: both run Army and Air Force aviation and base sustainment work; V2X has no NASA or DOE exposure, so the read covers only Amentum's DoD half.
findings.independence: Peer only. Opposite reads in the next finding (LDOS, BAH, PSN).

findings.finding: The federal services prints since Amentum last spoke share a pattern: EPS beats and raised profit guides with revenue shortfalls, and the market sold the revenue. Leidos (2026-11-03) beat EPS, missed revenue and cut its revenue outlook, about -6.5%. Booz Allen (2026-10-23) had revenue -3.9% and narrowed its revenue guide, with a mixed reaction. Parsons (2026-10-28) narrowed its guide and fell on weak guidance. This is the reaction function Amentum faced in August.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: AMTM Q3 FY26: an EPS beat and EPS guide raise with a revenue cut fell 8.2%, the same pattern.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a statement about the reaction, not the number. The put skew partly reflects it already. Not unpriced information, so sized small.
findings.independence: BAH: https://www.govconwire.com/articles/booz-allen-2-8b-q2-fy2027-revenue-financial-results (2026-10-23); PSN: https://www.webull.com/news/15825822278968320 (2026-10-28). Separate companies and documents.

baseline_tension: My evidence is balanced and agrees mildly with the +6.5-point put skew and the -5% 20-day run-up on the sign of the peer reaction function, but the bearish positioning near lows offsets it, so the number stays near zero.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (inside the guide): the FCF finding lands inside a guide the company reaffirmed with the YTD figure in hand, so -1.0 became -0.6. The NASA finding is inside a headwind management already framed at 3%, so -1.0 became -0.6.
Rule 1 (verified fact is not a reaction): this name sold an EPS beat in Q3, so the Q4 seasonality revenue finding went from +1.0 to +0.8 and print_vs_bar from +1.0 to +0.8.
Rule 5 (proxies smaller, not dropped): the CR/shutdown finding went from -0.5 to -0.3, the V2X peer read from +0.4 to +0.3, and the LDOS/BAH/PSN reaction pattern from -0.8 to -0.6.
Rule 7 (positioning): short interest is about 9% of float, not crowded, so the squeeze finding went from +0.8 to +0.6. No negative is large enough to need a squeeze haircut beyond that.
Press-released awards are mostly priced, so bookings went from +0.5 to +0.4. abs_move_pct (11.0) and p_up (48) are unchanged, so expected_move_pct is unchanged at -0.44.
